name: site-header
title: Site Header
description: A floating pill header for public sites: brand, a named navigation whose links move into a More panel as the bar narrows (measured, in order, no breakpoint), dropdowns for grouped links, calls to action, and a drawer with every link on narrow screens. It sets data-scrolled once the page scrolls.
docs: Put a `SkipLink` first in ``, then the header: `Skip to content…} items={[{ label: "Pricing", href: "/pricing", current: true }, { label: "Solutions", items: […] }]} actions={} />…`. `renderLink={(item) => }` (or `render` per item) uses your router's link. It sticks `--floating-offset` below the top of its scroll container; set `--site-header-width` to change its 64rem cap. `moreLabel`, `menuLabel` and `closeLabel` are English by default. Style the scrolled state with `group-data-scrolled/site-header:`.
